segments.textZh: Tesla的产品路线图极具吸引力。是的，所以，但我们不想过多谈论未来的产品，只能说我认为它们非常令人兴奋。

segments.textEn: How you, will you guarantee energy supply for the factory and will you for example, install pv?
segments.textZh: 您会如何，您会保障工厂的能源供应？例如，您会安装光伏设备吗？

segments.textEn: Yeah, absolutely. We're going to put PV on the photovoltaics on the roof of the factory and maybe on the ground as well. And so our goal is to have 100% renewable energy for the cycling.
segments.textZh: 是的，当然。我们会把PV，把光伏设备安装在工厂屋顶上，也可能安装在地面上。所以我们的目标是让循环过程使用100%的可再生能源。

segments.textEn: Will you also install superchargers at the factories?
segments.textZh: 您也会在工厂安装超级充电桩吗？

segments.textEn: No, no, of course we will. Yes, definitely.
segments.textZh: 不，不，我们当然会。是的，肯定会。

segments.textEn: This is kindergarten for employees.
segments.textZh: 这是给员工的幼儿园。

segments.textEn: A lot of details here. Yeah, we'll, we'll have a kindergarten.
segments.textZh: 这里有很多细节。是的，我们会，我们会有一所幼儿园。

segments.textEn: We'll certainly take care of people who have families and whatnot. So yes, I'm sure for children.
segments.textZh: 我们当然会照顾那些有家庭之类的人。所以是的，我确信，是为了孩子们。

segments.textEn: When will we have solar roof in Germany?
segments.textZh: 我们什么时候能在德国拥有太阳能屋顶？

segments.textEn: Hopefully next year.
segments.textZh: 希望明年。

segments.textEn: Do you invest in further nature protection projects in Brandenburg?
segments.textZh: 您会在勃兰登堡进一步投资自然保护项目吗？

segments.textEn: Yeah, absolutely, yeah, of course, yeah, we've had.
segments.textZh: 是的，当然，是的，当然，是的，我们已经有过。

segments.textEn: Advisory.
segments.textZh: 咨询。

segments.textEn: Hector, What can you do to make cell production more sustainable?
segments.textZh: 赫克托，您能做些什么来让电芯生产更具可持续性？

segments.textEn: Well, cell production I think is actually quite sustainable and especially long term you can just recycle the batteries. So you don't really need to do incremental mining. Once the, once the fleet is converted to electric, then very little incremental mining is needed. And I think most, the vast majority of cells will be iron based and there's lots of iron in the world. So it's really. And lithium is extremely common.
segments.textZh: 嗯，我认为电芯生产实际上相当可持续，尤其是从长期来看，你完全可以回收电池。所以你其实不需要进行增量采矿。一旦，一旦车队转为电动车，那么只需要非常少的增量采矿。而且我认为大多数、绝大多数电芯将以铁为基础，而世界上有很多铁。所以这真的。而且锂极其常见。

segments.textEn: So the main ingredients of the most common form of lithium ion are extremely, there's not a real limitation. They're quite easy to get. Nickel for that long range vehicles is a little more difficult than iron actually. 10 times more difficult technically. But I think nickel will really be used a lot before long range cars and for aircraft and then everything else will be iron based.
segments.textZh: 所以最常见形式的锂离子电池的主要成分极其，不存在真正的限制。它们相当容易获得。用于那些长续航车辆的镍其实比铁更难获取。从技术上说难10倍。但我认为，镍确实会在长续航汽车之前被大量使用，也会用于飞机，然后其他所有东西都会以铁为基础。

segments.textEn: And then yeah, lithium is extremely common. So there's really no, I wouldn't worry too much about the, you know, I think it's from a primal standpoint, pretty straight, pretty straightforward I mean, there is in cell phones and laptops, there's a lot of cobalt used, which is. That's a more challenging situation. But it tells that we use almost. No, no cobalt. And in the iron chemistry packs, we used none at all.
segments.textZh: 然后，是的，锂极其常见。所以真的没有，我不会太担心这个，你知道，我认为从原始的角度来看，这相当直接、相当简单。我的意思是，手机和笔记本电脑使用了大量钴，而这。这是一个更具挑战性的情况。但它表明我们几乎使用。不，不使用钴。而在铁化学体系的电池包中，我们完全不使用钴。

segments.textEn: Can't you make the entire car in one cast?
segments.textZh: 您不能把整辆汽车一次铸造成型吗？

segments.textEn: It's not.
segments.textZh: 这并不。

segments.textEn: It's not impossible, but I'm not sure you'd want to do that, because most of a car, the upper portion of a car is glass, and so it's actually a small amount of metal in the upper portion of the car. Not impossible to cast. But I'm not sure you'd want to. Yeah, exactly. Just cast the doors and chip them off or something.
segments.textZh: 这并非不可能，但我不确定你是否会想那么做，因为汽车的大部分，汽车的上半部分是玻璃，所以汽车上半部分实际上只有少量金属。并非不可能铸造。但我不确定你是否会想那么做。是的，没错。就把车门也铸进去，然后把它们凿下来之类的。

segments.textEn: So, yeah, it's not impossible, but I think it's probably unwise.
segments.textZh: 所以，是的，这并非不可能，但我认为那可能不明智。

segments.textEn: Anyway, I think everyone will take a couple more questions.
segments.textZh: 不管怎样，我想大家还会再回答几个问题。

segments.textEn: So.
segments.textZh: 那么。

segments.textEn: What innovations are you most proud of in Giga for the environment?
segments.textZh: 在超级工厂的环保创新中，您最自豪的是哪些？

segments.textEn: Well, I think we are going to have the front casting, and in volume production, we'll have front casting, the structural battery pack.
segments.textZh: 嗯，我认为我们将采用前部铸件，而且在规模化生产中，我们将采用前部铸件、结构电池包。

segments.textEn: This makes the car more efficient. And in general, we'll also be making the, I think, the most advanced battery cell here, the 4680. The paint shop is also extremely good. It's like, I think, the best paint shop in the world. So this is a lot of great things, and there'll be more to come.
segments.textZh: 这让汽车效率更高。而且总体来说，我们还会在这里生产，我认为，最先进的电池电芯，也就是4680。喷漆车间也极其出色。它就像是，我认为，世界上最好的喷漆车间。所以这里有很多很棒的东西，而且未来还会有更多。

segments.textEn: Est.
segments.textZh: 估。

segments.textEn: To which countries will Giga Berlin deliver its car then? As a last question?
segments.textZh: 那么，柏林超级工厂会把汽车交付到哪些国家？作为最后一个问题？

segments.textEn: Sure. The cars are meant to be delivered anywhere in sort of Greater Europe area, you know, so it's just obviously a lot more efficient environment if we don't put cars on ships and transport them halfway around the world. So it's really, you know, anywhere in the Greater Europe.
segments.textZh: 当然。这些汽车是要交付到大欧洲地区任何地方的，你知道，所以很明显，如果我们不用船运汽车、不把它们运到半个地球之外，环境效率会高得多。所以其实就是，你知道，大欧洲的任何地方。

segments.textEn: All right, Duncan, thanks a lot.
segments.textZh: 好的，邓肯，非常感谢。

segments.textEn: It's.
segments.textZh: 它是。

segments.textZh: 那里。
